method: Read-only live HTTP diagnostics and manual official-source cross-checks. Not independent-agent A/B testing.
interpretation: Legacy API does not support the added access/authentication filters. Identical results demonstrate why strict constraints need a separately versioned boundary; not a failure of a promised legacy feature. No throughput or latency percentile inference.

officialChecks.question: Is vgpu hosted MCP read-only and no-auth? What about local MCP?
officialChecks.conclusion: Hosted MCP agrees with the record. Bare local stdio defaults to read-only; writes require an explicit output boundary. local-write-opt-in is a capability label, not runtime mode. Exact configuration matching remains out of scope.

officialChecks.question: Does OpenCode HTTP server always require authentication?
officialChecks.conclusion: Server HTTP basic authentication is optionally enabled by OPENCODE_SERVER_PASSWORD. This differs from model-provider credentials. The local record's optional authentication is supported.

officialChecks.question: Do Microduck policy roles have explicit input/output shapes and independent upstream hosting?
officialChecks.conclusion: The pinned README specifies [1,61] observations and [1,14] actions; 51-wide policies are rejected by the documented loader. Roles map to training-run files. Separate Hub hosting is planned, not established. Shapes/provenance/hosting agree with local facts; this does not certify runtime compatibility.

limitations: Three purposive source checks, not a random sample or blinded score.
Source body size is not model input tokens. vgpu already offers compact Markdown, so full HTML is an unfair baseline.
No automatic tool invocation, shader execution, or physical robot operation.
The new endpoints have only local tests; public API probes concern the unchanged legacy API.
